senses: (ὀδύνη), to cause pain or suffering; pass. and mid., to suffer pain, be tormented or greatly distressed: [[r:LUK.2.48|Luk 2:48 16:24-25]] (ὀδυνᾶσαι, see M, Pr., 53 f.); before ἐπί, [[r:ACT.20.38|Act 20:38.]]† (AS)
pain, distress, of body or mind : [[r:ROM.9.2|Rom 9:2]], [[r:1TI.6.10|1Ti 6:10]].† (AS)

G3602.root: from a derivative of the base of [[w:G1416]]
senses: (ὀδύρομαι, to lament), lamentation, mourning: [[r:MAT.2.18|Mat 2:18]] (LXX), [[r:2CO.7.7|2Co 7:7.]]† (AS)
Ὀζείας (Rec. Ὀζίας), -ου, ὁ (Heb. עֻזִּיָּה), Uzziah: [[r:MAT.18.1|Mat 18:1-35 9:1-38]].† (AS)

G3605.root: a primary verb (in a strengthened form)
senses: ὄζω to smell (i.e. emit a smell): [[r:JHN.11.39|Jhn 11:39.]]† (AS)

G3606.root: from [[w:G3739]] with the directive enclitic of source
G3606.strongs: from which place or source or cause (adverb or conjunction)
senses: ὅθεν adv., whence;

of direction or source: [[r:MAT.12.44|Mat 12:44]], [[r:LUK.11.24|Luk 11:24]], [[r:ACT.14.26|Act 14:26 28:13]]; = ἐκεῖθεν ὅπου, [[r:MAT.25.24|Mat 25:24, 26]] (cf. Thuc., i, 89, 3); ὅ. γινώσκομεν, [[r:1JN.2.18|1Jn 2:18]];

G3607.strongs: a linen cloth, i.e. (especially) a sail
senses: (of Semitic origin, cf. Heb. אֵטוּן, yarn)
fine linen (Hom., al.).
Later, a sheet or sail: [[r:ACT.10.11|Act 10:11 11:5]].† (AS)

G3608.root: neuter of a presumed derivative of [[w:G3607]]
senses: (dimin. of ὀθόνη, which see), a piece of fine linen, a linen cloth; [[r:LUK.24.12|Luk 24:12]] (WH, R, mg., om.), [[r:JHN.19.40|Jhn 19:40 20:5-7]].† (AS)

G3609.strongs: domestic, i.e. (as noun), a relative, adherent
senses: (οἶκος), in or of the house (opposite to ξένος, ἀλλότριος);
of things; τὰ οἰ., household affairs or goods;

of persons, of the same family or kin; as subst., οἱ οἰ., kinsmen: [[r:1TI.5.8|1Ti 5:8]]; with genitive of person(s), of the family of: metaphorically, τ. θεον, [[r:EPH.2.19|Eph 2:19]]; τ. πίστεως (Lft., in l), [[r:GAL.6.10|Gal 6:10.]]† SYN,: συγγενής, ἴδιος (see Cremer, 446; Deiss., BS, 123) (AS)

G3610.strongs: a fellow resident, i.e. menial domestic
senses: (οἰκέω), a house-servant: [[r:LUK.16.13|Luk 16:13]], [[r:ROM.14.4|Rom 14:4]]; pl., [[r:ACT.10.7|Act 10:7]], [[r:1PE.2.18|1Pe 2:18]] (In Plat., Hdt., [[r:SIR.4.30|Sir 4:30 6:11]], the pl. includes all the inmates of the house, the familia, οἰκετεία.)† SYN.. see: διάκονος (AS)

G3611.strongs: to occupy a house, i.e. reside (figuratively, inhabit, remain, inhere); by implication, to cohabit
senses: (οἶκος),
trans., to inhabit: with accusative, [[r:1TI.6.16|1Ti 6:16]];

intrans., to dwell: before μετά (of married life), [[r:1CO.7.12|1Co 7:12-13]]; metaphorically, before ἐν: ἀγαθόν, [[r:ROM.7.18|Rom 7:18]]; ἁμαρτία, [[r:ROM.7.20|Rom 7:20]]; πνεῦμα θεοῦ, [[r:ROM.8.9|Rom 8:9, 11]], [[r:1CO.3.16|1Co 3:16]] (cf. ἐν-, κατ-, ἐν-κατ-, παρ-, περι-, συν-οικέω).† (AS)
(οἰκέω), a dwelling. As a euphemism for other definite terms (e.g. brothel. Hdt., ii, 121; cf. Ez, l.with), a prison (Thus., iv, 47 f.); [[r:ACT.12.7|Act 12:7.]]† (AS)

G3613.root: neuter of a presumed derivative of [[w:G3611]] (equivalent to [[w:G3612]])
senses: (οἰκητήρ = οἰκήτωρ, an inhabitant), a habitation: Ju 6; trop., [[r:2CO.5.2|2Co 5:2.]]† (AS)

G3614.strongs: properly, residence (abstractly), but usually (concretely) an abode (literally or figuratively); by implication, a family (especially domestics)
senses: (οἶκος), a house, dwelling: [[r:MAT.2.11|Mat 2:11 7:24-27]], [[r:MRK.1.29|Mrk 1:29]], al.; ἐν οἰκίᾳ (= cl. κατ ̓ οἰκίαν), at home, [[r:LUK.8.27|Luk 8:27]]; εἰς οἰ., II Jn 10; οἰ, with genitive of person(s), usually has the art. ([[r:MAT.8.14|Mat 8:14]], al., but cf. οἶκος and see Bl., § 46, 9); ἡ οἰ. τ. πατρός μου, [[r:JHN.14.2|Jhn 14:2.]] Metaphorical,
of the body as the dwelling of the soul: [[r:2CO.5.1|2Co 5:1]];

of property (as בַּיִת, [[r:GEN.45.18|Gen 45:18]], LXX, τ. υπάρχοντα; [[r:1KI.13.8|3Ki 13:8]], LXX, οἶκος) = οἶκος (which see): [[r:MRK.12.40|Mrk 12:40]], [[r:LUK.20.47|Luk 20:47]]; (with) of the inmates of the dwelling, the household: [[r:MAT.12.25|Mat 12:25]]; with genitive of person(s), [[r:JHN.4.53|Jhn 4:53]], [[r:1CO.16.15|1Co 16:15]] SYN.: οἶκος, which in Attic law denoted the whole estate, οἰκία, the dwelling only. In cl. poets οἶκος has also the latter sense, but not in prose, except in metaphorically usage, where it signifies both property and household. The foregoing distinction is not, however, consistently maintained in late Greek; cf. MM, ii, xvii, and see Thayer, see word οἰκία (AS)
(οἰκία), = οἰκεῖος belonging to the household, one's own: [[r:MAT.10.36|Mat 10:36]]; opposite to οἰκοδεσπότης, [[r:MAT.10.25|Mat 10:25.]]† (AS)

G3616.strongs: to be the head of (i.e. rule) a family
senses: οἰκο-δεσποτέω, -ῶ (οἰκοδεσπότης) to rule a household: [[r:1TI.5.14|1Ti 5:14.]]† (AS)

G3617.kjv: goodman (of the house), householder, master of the house
senses: οἰκο-δεσπότης, -ου, ὁ (οἶκος, δεσπότης), the master of a house, a householder: [[r:MAT.10.25|Mat 10:25 13:27 20:11 24:43]], [[r:MRK.14.14|Mrk 14:14]], [[r:LUK.12.39|Luk 12:39 13:25 14:21]]; ἄνθρωπος οἰ., [[r:MAT.13.52|Mat 13:52 20:1 21:33]]; pleonast., oἰ. τ. οἰκίας, [[r:LUK.22.11|Luk 22:11]] (see Bl., § 81, 4).† (AS)

G3618.strongs: to be a house-builder, i.e. construct or (figuratively) confirm
senses: (οἰκοδόμος), to build a house, to build: absol., [[r:LUK.11.48|Luk 11:48 14:30 17:28]]; οἱ οἰκοδομοῦντες, the builders (as [[r:PSA.118.22|Psa 118:22]], בָּנָה), [[r:MAT.21.42|Mat 21:42]], [[r:MRK.12.10|Mrk 12:10]], [[r:LUK.20.17|Luk 20:17]], [[r:1PE.2.7|1Pe 2:7]]" (LXX); ἐ π ̓ ἀλλότριον θεμέλιον οἰ., proverb., [[r:ROM.15.20|Rom 15:20]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[r:GAL.2.18|Gal 2:18]]; πύργον), [[r:MAT.21.33|Mat 21:33]], [[r:MRK.12.1|Mrk 12:1]], [[r:LUK.14.28|Luk 14:28]]; ἀποθήκας, [[r:LUK.12.18|Luk 12:18]]; ναόν, [[r:MRK.14.58|Mrk 14:58]]; pass., [[r:JHN.2.20|Jhn 2:20]]; οἰκία, [[r:LUK.6.48|Luk 6:48]]; with accusative of thing(s) before dative of person(s) (cf. [[r:GEN.8.20|Gen 8:20]], [[r:EZK.16.24|Eze 16:24]]), [[r:LUK.7.5|Luk 7:5]], [[r:ACT.7.47|Act 7:47, 49]]; accusative before ἐπί, [[r:MAT.7.24|Mat 7:24, 26]] [[r:LUK.6.49|Luk 6:49]]; πόλιν ἐπ ̓ ὄρους, [[r:LUK.4.29|Luk 4:29]]; of rebuilding, or restoring, [[r:MAT.23.29|Mat 23:29 26:61 27:40]], [[r:MRK.15.29|Mrk 15:29]], [[r:LUK.11.47|Luk 11:47]], Metaphorical, τ. ἐκκλησίαν, [[r:MAT.16.18|Mat 16:18]]; of the growth of Christian character (cf. בָּנָה, in [[r:PSA.28.5|Psa 28:5]], [[r:JER.24.6|Jer 24:6]], al.), to build up (AV, edify): absol., [[r:ACT.20.32|Act 20:32]], [[r:1CO.8.1|1Co 8:1 10:23]]; with accusative of person(s), [[r:1CO.14.4|1Co 14:4]], [[r:1TH.5.11|1Th 5:11]]; pass., [[r:ACT.9.31|Act 9:31]], [[r:1CO.14.17|1Co 14:17]], [[r:1PE.2.5|1Pe 2:5]]; of blameworthy action (AV, embolden), [[r:1CO.8.10|1Co 8:10]] (cf. ἀν-, ἐπ-, συν-οικοδομέω).† οἰκο-δόμος, -ου, ὁ (οἶκος + δέμω, to build), a builder: [[r:ACT.4.11|Act 4:11.]]† (AS)

G3619.root: feminine (abstract) of a compound of [[w:G3624]] and the base of [[w:G1430]]
G3619.strongs: architecture, i.e. (concretely) a structure; figuratively, confirmation
senses: (οἶκος, + δέμω, to build), = cl. οἰκοδομία (which see), -δόμησις (Thuc., Plat.),

the act of building; in NT always metaphorically, building up, edifying: [[r:ROM.14.19|Rom 14:19 15:2]], [[r:1CO.14.26|1Co 14:26]], [[r:2CO.10.8|2Co 10:8 13:10]], [[r:EPH.4.29|Eph 4:29]]; with genitive obj., [[r:1CO.14.12|1Co 14:12]], [[r:2CO.12.19|2Co 12:19]], [[r:EPH.4.12|Eph 4:12, 16]]; λαλεῖν, λαβεῖν, οἰ., [[r:1CO.14.3|1Co 14:3.]]
= οἰκοδόμημα, a building: [[r:MAT.24.1|Mat 24:1]], [[r:MRK.13.1|Mrk 13:1-2]]; metaphorically, [[r:1CO.3.9|1Co 3:9]], [[r:2CO.5.1|2Co 5:1]], [[r:EPH.2.21|Eph 2:21]].† (AS)

G3621.strongs: to manage (a house, i.e. an estate)
senses: (οἰκονόμος), to manage as house-steward, be a steward: absol., [[r:LUK.16.2|Luk 16:2]]; hence, generally (see: οἰκονομία), to manage, regulate, arrange (cl., 2Mac, Lc., [[r:3MA.3.2|3Ma 3:2]] R).† (AS)

G3622.strongs: administration (of a household or estate); specially, a (religious) "economy"
senses: (οἰκονομέω),
prop. (Plat., Arist.), the office of οἰκονόμος, stewardship: [[r:LUK.16.2|Luk 16:2-4.]]

In later writers (Plut., al.; see AR on [[r:EPH.1.10|Eph 1:10]]; MM, xviii), generally, administration, dispensation: [[r:1CO.9.17|1Co 9:17]], [[r:EPH.1.10|Eph 1:10 3:2, 9]], [[r:COL.1.25|Col 1:25]], [[r:1TI.1.4|1Ti 1:4]].† (AS)

G3623.strongs: a house-distributor (i.e. manager), or overseer, i.e. an employee in that capacity; by extension, a fiscal agent (treasurer); figuratively, a preacher (of the Gospel)
senses: (οἶκος + νέμω, to manage)

prop., the manager of a household or estate, a house- or land-steward (usually a slave or freedman): [[r:LUK.12.42|Luk 12:42 16:1, 3 16:8]], [[r:1CO.4.2|1Co 4:2]], [[r:GAL.4.2|Gal 4:2]]; ὀ οἰ. τ. πόλεως (RV, treasurer; cf. I [[r:EST.4.49|Est 4:49]]), [[r:ROM.16.23|Rom 16:23]].

Metaphorical (in wider sense; cf. οἰκονομία), an administrator, a steward: of Christian ministers, [[r:1CO.4.1|1Co 4:1]], [[r:TIT.1.7|Tit 1:7]]; of Christians generally, [[r:1PE.4.10|1Pe 4:10.]]† (AS)

G3624.strongs: a dwelling (more or less extensive, literal or figurative); by implication, a family (more or less related, literally or figuratively)
senses: prop., a house, dwelling: [[r:ACT.2.2|Act 2:2 19:16]]; with genitive poss., [[r:MAT.9.6|Mat 9:6]], 7 [[r:MRK.2.11|Mrk 2:11]], [[r:LUK.1.23|Luk 1:23]], al.; with genitive attrib., ἐμπορίου, [[r:JHN.2.16|Jhn 2:16]]; προσευχῆς, [[r:MAT.21.13|Mat 21:13]], al.; of a sanctuary (Hdt., Eur.): οἶ. τ. θεοῦ, of the tabernacle, [[r:MAT.12.4|Mat 12:4]], al.; the temple, [[r:MAT.21.13|Mat 21:13]], al.; metaphorically of a city: [[r:MAT.23.38|Mat 23:38]], [[r:LUK.13.35|Luk 13:35]]; of the body, [[r:MAT.12.44|Mat 12:44]], [[r:LUK.11.24|Luk 11:24]]; of Christians, [[r:1PE.2.5|1Pe 2:5]]; ἐν οἴ (M, Pr., 81f.), at home, [[r:MRK.2.1|Mrk 2:1]], [[r:1CO.11.34|1Co 11:34 14:35]]; so κατ ̓ οἶκον, [[r:ACT.2.46|Act 2:46 5:42]]; οἱ εἰς (= οἱ ἐν; see: εἰς) τ. οἶ., [[r:LUK.7.10|Luk 7:10 15:6]]; κατ ̓οἴκους, from house to house, [[r:ACT.8.3|Act 8:3 20:20]]; εἰς (κατ ̓) οἶκον, with genitive (Bl., §46, 9), [[r:MRK.8.3|Mrk 8:3]], [[r:LUK.14.1|Luk 14:1]], [[r:ROM.16.5|Rom 16:5]], al.

By meton., a house, household, family: [[r:LUK.10.5|Luk 10:5]], [[r:ACT.7.10|Act 7:10]], [[r:1CO.1.16|1Co 1:16]], [[r:1TI.3.4|1Ti 3:4]], 5 al.; of the Church, ὁ οἶ. τ. θεοῦ, [[r:1TI.3.15|1Ti 3:15]], [[r:HEB.3.2|Heb 3:2]], [[r:1PE.4.17|1Pe 4:17]]; of descendants, οἶ Ἰσραήλ (Δαυείδ, Ἰακώβ; Bl, §47, 9), [[r:MAT.10.6|Mat 10:6]], [[r:LUK.1.27|Luk 1:27, 33]] al. (cf. [[r:EXO.6.14|Exo 6:14]], [[r:1SA.2.30|1Ki 2:30]], al.). SYN.: see: οἰκία. (AS)

G3625.root: feminine participle present passive of [[w:G3611]] (as noun, by implication, of [[w:G1093]])
G3625.strongs: land, i.e. the (terrene part of the) globe; specially, the Roman empire
senses: (fern. Pres. pass. ptcp. of οἰκέω; sc. γῆ) the inhabited earth;
in cl., the countries occupied by Greeks, as disting. from barbarian lands (Hdt., Dem., al.);

in later writers, the Roman world: [[r:LUK.2.1|Luk 2:1]], [[r:ACT.11.28|Act 11:28 24:5]]; by meton., of its inhabitants: [[r:ACT.17.6|Act 17:6 19:27]]; (with) in LXX ([[r:PSA.23.1|Psa 23:1 71:8]], al.) and NT, also of the whole inhabited world: [[r:MAT.24.14|Mat 24:14]], [[r:LUK.4.5|Luk 4:5 21:26]], [[r:ROM.10.18|Rom 10:18]], [[r:HEB.1.6|Heb 1:6]], [[r:REV.3.10|Rev 3:10 16:14]]; by meton. (ut supr.), [[r:ACT.17.31|Act 17:31]], [[r:REV.12.9|Rev 12:9]];
of the Messianic age, ἡ οἰ. ἡ μέλλουσα = ὁ αἰὼ ὁ μέλλων: [[r:HEB.2.5|Heb 2:5.]]† (AS)

G3626.strongs: be "ware"); a stayer at home, i.e. domestically inclined (a "good housekeeper")
senses: οἰκ-ουρός, -ον (οἶκος + οὖρος, a keeper)
watching or keeping the house; as subst., ἡ οἰ., a housekeeper (Soph., Eur.; see LS, see word).
keeping at home: [[r:TIT.2.5|Tit 2:5]], Rec. (see Field, Notes, 220 ff.; CGT, in l, and cf. οίκουργός).† (AS)
(οἶκτος, pity), to pity, have compassion on. with accusative of person(s), [[r:ROM.9.15|Rom 9:15]] (LXX).† SYN.: ἐλεέω, q.v (AS)

(οἰκτείρω), compassion, pity. σπλάγχνα οἰκτιρμοῦ, a heart of compassion, [[r:COL.3.12|Col 3:12]]; in pl. (as LXX for Heb. רַחַם), οἰ. τ. θεοῦ, [[r:ROM.12.1|Rom 12:1]], [[r:HEB.10.28|Heb 10:28]]; ό πατὴρ τῶν οἰ, [[r:2CO.1.3|2Co 1:3]]; σπλάγχνα κ. οἰ., [[r:PHP.2.1|Php 2:1.]]† SYN.: ἔλεος, q.v (AS)
(οἰκτείρω), in cl. poët, for ἐλεήμων (which see), merciful: [[r:LUK.6.36|Luk 6:36]], [[r:JAS.5.1|Jas 5:1]].† (AS)

G3630.root: from [[w:G3631]] and a derivative of the alternate of [[w:G4095]]
senses: οἰνο-πότης, -ου, ὁ (οίνος + πότης, a drinker), poët. and late prose, a wine-drinker, wine-bibber: [[r:MAT.11.19|Mat 11:19]], [[r:LUK.7.34|Luk 7:34]].† (AS)

G3631.root: a primary word (or perhaps of Hebrew origin ([[w:H3196]]))
senses: wine; [[r:MAT.9.17|Mat 9:17]], [[r:LUK.1.15|Luk 1:15]], [[r:JHN.2.3|Jhn 2:3]], al.; οἴνῳ προσέχειν, [[r:1TI.3.8|1Ti 3:8]]; δουλοῦσθαι, [[r:TIT.2.3|Tit 2:3.]] Metaphorical, [[r:REV.14.8|Rev 14:8, 10 16:19 17:2 18:3 19:15]]. By meton. for ἄμπελος, [[r:REV.6.6|Rev 6:6]] (AS)

G3632.root: from [[w:G3631]] and a form of the base of [[w:G5397]]
G3632.strongs: an overflow (or surplus) of wine, i.e. vinolency (drunkenness)
senses: (φλύω, to bubble up, overflow), cf. -γέω, [[r:DEU.21.20|Deu 21:20]] drunkenness, debauchery: [[r:1PE.4.3|1Pe 4:3.]]† SYN.: see: κραιπάλη (AS)

G3633.strongs: to make like (oneself), i.e. imagine (be of the opinion)
senses: to suppose, expect, imagine; with accusative and inf., [[r:JHN.21.25|Jhn 21:25]]; with inf., [[r:PHP.1.17|Php 1:17]]; before ὅτι, [[r:JAS.1.7|Jas 1:7.]]† οἶμαι, see: οἴομαι SYN.. see: ἡγέομαι (AS)

G3634.strongs: such or what sort of (as a correlation or exclamation); especially the neuter (adverbially) with negative, not so
G3634.kjv: so (as), such as, what (manner of), which
senses: relat. pron., qualitative (related to ὅς as qualis to qui), what sort or manner of, such as, in NT usually without its correl. τοιοῦτος: [[r:MAT.24.21|Mat 24:21]], [[r:MRK.9.3|Mrk 9:3]], [[r:2CO.12.20|2Co 12:20]], [[r:1TH.1.5|1Th 1:5]], [[r:2TI.3.11|2Ti 3:11]], [[r:REV.16.18|Rev 16:18]]; before τοιοῦτος, [[r:1CO.15.48|1Co 15:48 15:2]] [[r:2CO.10.11|2Co 10:11]]; id. redundant, [[r:MRK.13.19|Mrk 13:19]]; τ. αὑτὸν... σἷον, [[r:PHP.1.30|Php 1:30]]; οὐχ οἷον δὲ ὅτι, elliptically, but it is not as though (RV), [[r:ROM.9.6|Rom 9:6.]]† (AS)
(ὄκνος, shrinking, hesitation), to shrink from doing, hesitate to do (Hom., Thuc., al.); hence, to delay with inf., [[r:ACT.9.38|Act 9:38]] (cf. Nu, l.with, and see MM, xviii).† (AS)

(ὀκνέω), shrinking, hesitating, timid: with dative (Bl., § 38, 2), [[r:ROM.12.11|Rom 12:11]]; hence, slothful: [[r:MAT.25.26|Mat 25:26.]] Of things, that which causes shrinking, irksome: [[r:PHP.3.1|Php 3:1.]]† (AS)

G3637.strongs: an eight-day old person or act
senses: (ὀκτώ, ἡμέρα), of the eighth day, eight days old: with dative ref., περιτομῇ., [[r:PHP.3.5|Php 3:5]] (words of this class denote duration, cf. τεταρταῖος).† (AS)
indecl., eight: [[r:LUK.2.21|Luk 2:21]], [[r:JHN.5.5|Jhn 5:5]], al (AS)

G3639.strongs: a prolonged form); ruin, i.e. death, punishment
senses: (ὄλλυμι, to destroy), ruin, destruction, death: [[r:1TH.5.3|1Th 5:3]], [[r:1TI.6.9|1Ti 6:9]]; αἰώνιος, [[r:2TH.1.9|2Th 1:9]] (L, txt., ὀλέθριος, which see); εἰς ὄ. τῆς σαρκός, for physical discipline, to destroy carnal lusts, [[r:1CO.5.5|1Co 5:5.]]† (AS)
ὀλιγό-πιστος, -ον of little faith or trust: [[r:MAT.6.30|Mat 6:30 8:26 14:31 16:8]], [[r:LUK.12.28|Luk 12:28]].† (AS)

G3641.strongs: puny (in extent, degree, number, duration or value); especially neuter (adverbially) somewhat
G3641.kjv: + almost, brief(-ly), few, (a) little, + long, a season, short, small, a while
senses: (on οὐχ ὁλ., see infr.), of number, quantity, size, few, little, small, slight: [[r:MAT.9.37|Mat 9:37 15:34]], [[r:MRK.6.5|Mrk 6:5 8:7]], [[r:LUK.10.2|Luk 10:2 12:48]] (sc. πληγάς, opposite to πολλάς), [[r:1TI.5.23|1Ti 5:23]], [[r:HEB.12.10|Heb 12:10]], [[r:REV.3.4|Rev 3:4 12:12]]; οὐκ ὀ.
